review_scope: Retained-only independent review of the sole frozen n102 campaign. No code changes, campaign, build, suite, retry, tuning, baseline adoption, or active-profile mutation was performed.

release_decision.reason: The repaired graph producer is valid at every reference checkpoint, but the sole measured canonical trajectory fails every calibration floor, loses formerly correct OSIDs against both protected references at every checkpoint, fails six of sixteen required final anchors, fails one final consistency floor despite an identified legal donor, and retains formal exact-timing proxy failures. Passing health, producer, movement, provenance, preservation, and artifact-contract checks does not waive these acceptance failures.

minimal_next_retained_only_question.question: Using only retained n102 and clean n94/n98 (or n101 where its matching artifact exists), what is the earliest sector-assignment, operation, battle, or control-event divergence that causes the week-39 Donje Zesce and Tosici losses, and what later retained divergence begins the six-objective western-Bosnia shortfall?
minimal_next_retained_only_question.scope: One bounded event-and-sector timeline comparator over retained artifacts; begin at week 1 and stop after identifying the first causally relevant divergence for the early loss and the first boundary for the late western collapse.
minimal_next_retained_only_question.stop_condition: Stop if the retained artifacts cannot expose a source decision or causal boundary; report UNMEASURED without campaign, retry, tuning, code change, or baseline adoption.

reviewer_conclusion: The one-week graph repair corrected the scenario harness producer defect and generated structurally valid OSID graphs. Its actual canonical 188-week calibration impact is unacceptable under the frozen criteria: all four floors fail, formerly correct losses occur at all four checkpoints against both protected references, six required final anchors fail, and one final sector floor remains underfilled despite a legal donor. Toljenak and Prisoje demonstrate real normal combat captures at turns 134 and 187 respectively, so their exact-week proxy failures should be presented accurately rather than mistaken for missing combat; they nevertheless remain unwaived formal failures. Donji Vrbljani and the western-Bosnia shortfall are genuine outcome failures. The candidate remains NO_GO with no retry and no full-suite expansion.
